map.：10 分钟降水 2 mm → 折合 12 mm/h，属中雨；若 10 分钟 8: 10 minutes of 2 mm rain works out to 12 mm/h, which is moderate rain; 8 mm in 10 minutes gives 48 mm/h, heavy rain.
map.：雨强≥20 mm/h 或 ≥50 mm/h（1h）触发暴雨预警，城市内涝看雨强: An intensity of 20 mm/h or more, or 50 mm/h over 1 hour, triggers a rainstorm warning; for urban waterlogging look at the peak intensity rather than the total.
